reviews.title: Decent UV Protection, but Thin
reviews.comment: The rash guard fits well and the UV protection is noticeable during sunny days. However, the fabric feels thinner than I expected and offers little warmth after a while. Overall it's okay for a quick dip but I wish it were more durable.
